rule: P3 (the one writer of pack/adapters/hooks/*.json) adds each entry below to the named host config, additively - Claude Code's `hooks` object takes an array per event, so a second entry on an event is appended, never replaced. The command form is the README's run-time interpreter resolution; nothing machine-specific (PLAT-A/PLAT-B). Status per host is `observed-only` until a live session shows the hook refuse a stop (CO12); Antigravity is `unsupported` (no stop event documented) and gets no entry.

hooks.command: py=$(python3 -c 'import sys;print(sys.executable)' 2>/dev/null); [ -x "$py" ] || py=$(python -c 'import sys;print(sys.executable)'); "$py" docs/ai-forward-pack/hooks/owner-review-gate.py --host claude --event Stop

py=$(python3 -c 'import sys;print(sys.executable)' 2>/dev/null); [ -x "$py" ] || py=$(python -c 'import sys;print(sys.executable)'); "$py" docs/ai-forward-pack/hooks/owner-review-gate.py --host claude --event SubagentStop

py=$(python3 -c 'import sys;print(sys.executable)' 2>/dev/null); [ -x "$py" ] || py=$(python -c 'import sys;print(sys.executable)'); "$py" docs/ai-forward-pack/hooks/owner-review-gate.py --host grok --event Stop

copilot.ai-forward-hooks.json.note: the gate emits {"decision":"block","reason":...} with exit 0 on this host (Copilot's own block form, as mail-doorbell.py); subagentStop is handled by the script but not wired until the event is verified

agy.ai-forward-hooks.json.note: Antigravity documents no stop-class event; the script exits 0 for --host agy

readme: pack/adapters/hooks/README.md carries the table row and the per-host stop-event table (already written by P5)
verification: after applying: `python3 -m pytest -q tests/docs_explorer/test_coord_decide.py -k Gate` stays green; a live Claude Code session with AGENT_SESSION set and an open decision request it sent must see its Stop refused with the reason on stderr - that observation promotes the host to `enforced` in the README table
